classification.difficultyReason: Construct parallels through successive bends and combine a reflex complement with transferred angle differences.

spec.description: Open zigzag between upper and lower rightward horizontal arms. Both horizontal arms carry leftward parallel arrows. Vertices are unlabelled. No angle arcs are supplied.
spec.mathematics: Internal coordinate names U,V,W,X are not printed. From V, VU has direction 70 degrees and VW direction -50 degrees. From W, WX has direction 225 degrees. Thus the angle at U is 110 degrees, the reflex angle at V is 240 degrees, and the left-opening angle at W is 95 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Retain 110 degrees, reflex 240 degrees, 95 degrees and theta only. Construction lines and derived angles are solution-only.

answer.worked:
Construct horizontal lines through both intermediate bends, parallel to the marked lines.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=180^\circ-110^\circ\\\alpha&=70^\circ\end{align*}$$
Co-interior angles on parallel lines.
$$\begin{align*}\beta&=360^\circ-240^\circ\\\beta&=120^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles at a point.
$$\begin{align*}\gamma&=120^\circ-70^\circ\\\gamma&=50^\circ\end{align*}$$
The angle at the next bend is also $50^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).
$$\begin{align*}\delta&=95^\circ-50^\circ\\\delta&=45^\circ\end{align*}$$
$\theta=45^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).
